payload.claim: The docstring says 'The last of the four [single seeds] is a faked `git checkout`,' but the code runs the faked-checkout case third (inside the `single` tuple loop, lines 630-639) and the `_hook_timeout` case afterward, as a separate block (lines 641-644). The actual last single seed executed is the timeout case, not the faked checkout, so the docstring misdescribes the test's own structure.
